properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:11AM CDT until August 9 at 5:00AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
At 411 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over West Okoboji,
or near Spirit Lake, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

This severe storm will be near...
Spirit Lake, Milford, Arnolds Park, Okoboji, Orleans, Wahpeton,
and West Okoboji around 415 AM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather contact your nearest law enforcement agency.
They will send your report to the National Weather Service office in
Sioux Falls.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:29AM CDT until August 9 at 4:45AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
At 429 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Redfield,
moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of South Central Spink County.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:30AM CDT until August 9 at 4:45AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 430 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles northwest of
Pattonsburg, or 10 miles southeast of Albany, moving southeast at 30
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Albany, Pattonsburg, Coffey, Jameson, Darlington, and Mcfall.

This includes Interstate 35 in Missouri between mile markers 68 and
85.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
